title: 第三章 谁知道死的是三弟还是白宣第四章 这镇北王是字正淳吗
content_zh:
“小姨，怎么了？”
看着悲伤的段白语，许玉华疑惑，伤心她能理解，但“原来如此”是什么意思？
为什么声音中透露着悲愤，一股不祥的预感笼罩在许玉华的心头上。
“世安已经死了。宣儿是我义子。”段白语看着许玉华，说出残酷的真相。
“三弟死了？”
许玉华闻言如遭雷击，娇躯剧颤，露出不敢置信的神情。
死了？
怎么能死？
这天下间谁都能死，唯独三弟不能死！
一旁跟着许玉华进来，一直没有开口的老者骤然听闻消息，眼神之中浮现一抹骇人的精光，瞥了眼一旁的白宣，然后道：“王妃，此时事关重大，观中可有雅静地方详谈？”
段白语闻言，看向白宣道：“宣儿你帮我收拾，我去和他们商议。”
白宣点头，目送三人离开，一个人留在房内，实则暗暗运转玄功，感应笼罩整个玉真观，无论他们到何处，都能听得他们的声音。
他要成仙，得报恩。
但目前来看，这报恩的麻烦不小。
他原以为自家恩人转世，会和许仙差不多，出身贫寒，自己帮她实现梦想，让她富贵，无论是嫁给心爱的郎君还是招个赘婿守住家业，都无妨。
了不得就是富豪之后，以他这一身实力，总能帮她实现梦想。
哪里想到除了一样姓许之外，就没有共同点了。
镇北王府的郡主。
这身份可不简单，镇北王的名声他也是听过的，大周军神，异姓封王，在三十年前的八王之乱中，辅佐晋王即位，攻无不克，战无不胜，扫平藩王，又连灭三国。
镇守凉、并州二州，无论是妖国的大妖还是北荒的荒人都惧他如虎。

所以许玉华不是公主，但也和公主没什么区别了，甚至更加的自在。
眼下的麻烦，似乎是她爹死了，她兄弟死了，没人继承她爹的王位，她未来的地位会受到影响。
可自己怎么帮她呢？
总不能自荐枕席，入赘到她家，让她生个孩子，继承镇北王府吧。
且不说这样生出来的孩子，继承不了爵位，就说时间上也来不及啊。
他和许玉华的实力差距太大，努力几十年，都不一定能造出一个娃来。
而且真造出来了，把因果了了，他抛妻弃子，飞升成仙？
他怕自己到时候狠不下心。
得吸取前辈的前车之鉴啊。
单纯的报恩，不成亲，不生孩子，不给自己制造麻烦。
白宣心中思索，耳旁也传来了声音，当即凝神静听。
却说段白语、许玉华、老者来到一间密室。
“小姨，到底发生了什么？玉真观的守卫不弱，是谁杀害了三弟。”
几步路的时间，许玉华勉强控制好了自己的情绪，看向段白语道。
“血影教。”
段白语将事情缓缓说出。
“该死的爬虫，也敢对我镇北王府下手，回去后，必倾尽镇北王府之力，剿灭血影教。”那老者听闻血影教三个字，顿时面色凌厉，好似一头暴怒的猛虎。
许玉华清冽的眼眸之中也浮现出一抹杀机。
“如果仲文还在，当如此，可如今的镇北王府还在我们的掌控中吗？”段白语却问出了更关键的问题。
content_en:
"Auntie, what's wrong?"
Looking at the sad Duan Baiyu, Xu Yuhua was confused. She could understand being sad, but what did "so that's how it is" mean?
Why was there sadness and anger in the voice, and an ominous premonition enveloped Xu Yuhua's heart.
"Shi'an is dead. Xuan'er is my adopted son." Duan Baiyu looked at Xu Yuhua and told the cruel truth.
"Third brother is dead?"
Xu Yuhua felt as if he was struck by lightning when he heard this, his delicate body trembled violently, showing an expression of disbelief.
Dead?
How could he die?
Anyone in this world can die, except my third brother!
Xu Yuhua followed him in. The old man who had been silent until he heard the news suddenly heard the news. A frightening light appeared in his eyes. He glanced at Bai Xuan and said, "Princess, this matter is of great importance. Is there a quiet place in the audience to discuss it in detail?"
Hearing this, Duan Baiyu looked at Bai Xuan and said, "Xuan'er, please help me clean up. I'll go discuss it with them."
Bai Xuan nodded and watched the three people leave. He stayed alone in the room, but he was secretly running the Xuan Gong, and the induction enveloped the entire Yuzhen Temple. No matter where they went, their voices could be heard.
He wants to become an immortal and repay his kindness.
But currently, this repayment of gratitude is quite troublesome.
He originally thought that in the reincarnation of his benefactor, he would be similar to Xu Xian, born in poverty, and he would help her realize her dream and make her rich, whether it was marrying her beloved husband or recruiting a son-in-law to protect the family business.
It's amazing that after becoming a rich man, with his strength, he can always help her realize her dream.
It never occurred to me that apart from the same surname of Xu, they had nothing in common.
The princess of Zhenbei Palace.
This identity is not simple. He has also heard of the reputation of King Zhenbei. He is the military god of the Great Zhou Dynasty and has a different surname. During the Eight Kings Rebellion thirty years ago, he assisted the King of Jin to ascend the throne. He was invincible in all attacks and battles, wiped out the vassal kings, and destroyed three kingdoms in a row.
Guarding the two states of Liang and Bingzhou, both the great demons of the Demon Kingdom and the barren people of the Northern Wilderness feared him like a tiger.
So Xu Yuhua is not a princess, but she is no different from a princess, and even more comfortable.
The current trouble seems to be that her father is dead, her brother is dead, and no one will succeed her father's throne, which will affect her future status.
But how can I help her?
You can't recommend yourself as a pillow, marry into her house, let her have a child, and inherit the Zhenbei Palace.
Not to mention that a child born in this way cannot inherit the title, but there is not enough time.
The gap in strength between him and Xu Yuhua was too great. After decades of hard work, they might not be able to create a baby.
And it was really created, and the cause and effect were solved. He abandoned his wife and children and ascended to immortality?
He was afraid that he would not be able to be cruel when the time came.
We have to learn from the mistakes of our predecessors.
To simply repay a favor, don't get married, don't have children, don't cause trouble for yourself.
Bai Xuan was thinking in his heart, and heard a voice in his ear, and he immediately listened attentively.
But Duan Baiyu, Xu Yuhua, and the old man came to a secret room.
"Auntie, what happened? The guards at Yuzhen Temple are not weak. Who killed the third brother?"
After a few steps, Xu Yuhua managed to control his emotions, looked at Duan Bai and said.
"Blood Shadow Cult."
Duan Baiyu slowly told the story.
"The damn reptile dares to attack my Zhenbei Palace. After I return, I will use all the Zhenbei Palace's power to destroy the Blood Shadow Sect." When the old man heard the three words Blood Shadow Sect, his expression suddenly became sharp, like an angry tiger.
A trace of murderous intent also appeared in Xu Yuhua's clear eyes.
"If Zhongwen is still here, that's the case, but is the Zhenbei Palace still under our control?" Duan Baiyu asked a more critical question.
